{{Top|leg}}
A '''section''' was a small unit of military forces in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as well as in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The number and type of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in Rebel sections varied due to mission requirements. It usually included three to twelve [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] and [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] under the command of the most senior ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> In the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], one section contained between two and four ships.<ref name="TEGtW" />
